hardware.name: JAC-Bus300-Telemetry-Chassis
hardware.description: Standard LEO bus chassis providing power distribution, solar propulsion control, orbit status, thermal monitoring, and attitude control.

hardware.name: O-DU Payload Processor Unit
hardware.description: Regenerative space-grade Distributed Unit card with AMD/Xilinx Versal adaptive SoC. Processes MAC, RLC, and High-PHY 5G NTN layers under extreme radiation conditions.

hardware.name: O-RU Digital Front End (DFE) payload
hardware.description: Space-grade Radio Unit frontend supporting Open Front-haul Option-7.2x, dynamic digital up/downconversion, and packet synchronization.

hardware.name: Ku/Ka Band Active Phased Array (AESA)
hardware.description: Active Electronically Scanned Array implementing high-gain dynamic beamforming for 5G-NR user/feeder links.

hardware.name: Locked GNSS Space Disciplined Clock
hardware.description: Radiation-hardened GNSS-locked reference oscillator. Provides ultra-stable sub-nanosecond synchronization, satisfying O-RAN ITU-T G.8275.1 standards to compensate for high Doppler shift.

hardware.name: Laser Terminal Inter-Satellite Link (ISL)
hardware.description: 100 Gbps coherent Laser Communication Terminal (LCT) for intra-orbit satellite-to-satellite backhaul. Controlled by fine-pointing mechanism.

ietfInterfaces.name: sat-1/f1-u
ietfInterfaces.description: F1-User plane interface mapping active O-DU backhaul to ground gateway via NTN link

ietfInterfaces.name: sat-1/open-front-haul
ietfInterfaces.description: eCPRI front-haul connecting on-board O-DU component to O-RU component on payload bus

ietfInterfaces.name: sat-1/isl-port
ietfInterfaces.description: High-speed laser cross-link inter-satellite optical interface (100G Coherent Laser)
